description: XTFrame standard symbol library (docs/design/30-ui-project.md 30.4). One symbol per <Name>.xt; every symbol draws only through the tokens of tokens.xts.

symbols.name: Button
symbols.description: Push button with Kind and Size variants; emits `pressed` on click.

symbols.name: Toggle
symbols.description: On/off switch with a label.
symbols.notes: The switch is the checkbox input with its knob inside; its check / uncheck set the `value` port (`set(value, true|false)`). A host change of `value` does not move the switch (no `checked` binding target); the host sets that with setAttribute("checked").

symbols.name: Checkbox
symbols.description: Check box with a label.
symbols.notes: Same as Toggle: the box is the checkbox input with its mark inside; its check / uncheck set the `value` port.

symbols.name: RadioGroup
symbols.description: Single choice from a list of options (`<repeat>`).
symbols.notes: Controlled: the host sets `value` (selected index) on `select`; a trigger cannot set a state on a sibling, so the group cannot select locally.

symbols.name: Slider
symbols.description: Horizontal value slider with a readout.
triggers: drag.value: set(value, event.value | range(0, 1, min, max) | round)
nav.value: sound(ui_tick); if lt(0) emit(decrease) else emit(increase)
symbols.notes: The track is `draggable="axis-x"`: a press or drag along it sets `value` (min..max, rounded); with the track focused, Left/Right keys and the gamepad d-pad emit `decrease` / `increase` (nav.value).

symbols.name: Stepper
symbols.description: Minus / value / plus control.
symbols.notes: Controlled: `decrease` / `increase` events, the host sets `value`.

symbols.name: Dropdown
symbols.description: Closed field that opens an option list on the overlay layer.
symbols.notes: The list sits inside the field, shown by the custom state Open; while Open the field is lifted into the overlay layer (`layer(overlay)` on state(Open).enter). The list is a `focus-trap`.

symbols.name: OptionCycler
symbols.description: Left/right option switcher (settings row).
symbols.notes: Controlled: `prev` / `next` events, the host sets `current`.

symbols.name: TextField
symbols.description: Single-line text input with a label and a localized placeholder.
symbols.notes: The placeholder is the key @xt_textfield_placeholder; Enter emits `submit`.

symbols.name: Tabs
symbols.description: Four tabs driven by the Tab state group.
triggers: click: sound(ui_tab); state(Tab1, on, target=#Box); emit(select)
click: sound(ui_tab); state(Tab2, on, target=#Box); emit(select)
click: sound(ui_tab); state(Tab3, on, target=#Box); emit(select)
click: sound(ui_tab); state(Tab4, on, target=#Box); emit(select)
symbols.notes: A click selects its tab directly (`state(TabN, on, target=#Box)`) and emits `select` from that tab's element; `value` (0-3) also selects the Tab1..Tab4 state.

symbols.name: Tooltip
symbols.description: Anchor with a tip shown on the overlay layer after a 600 ms hover.
symbols.notes: The 600 ms hover delay is a transition delay (the tip fades in on :hover).

symbols.name: Modal
symbols.description: Centered dialog over a scrim with title, body and action slots.
symbols.notes: The panel box is a `focus-trap` (navigation stays inside); intro plays on show, outro on hide (then hides).

symbols.name: Toast
symbols.description: Toast queue: a `<repeat>` whose entries slide in and out.
symbols.notes: Entries come and go with listInsert / listRemove; item-enter / item-exit play the item-in / item-out timelines.

symbols.name: ProgressBar
symbols.description: Labelled progress bar; value mapped with range().

symbols.name: CooldownRing
symbols.description: Radial cooldown indicator around an icon slot.
symbols.notes: The sweep is three stacked conic-gradient discs (no clipping); the host drives the `cooldown` timeline (1 s = 0-100 %) with playTimeline / seekTimeline. The sweep colours are tokens substituted at compile time (a theme recolours the dial and the ready state, not the sweep).

symbols.name: HealthBar
symbols.description: Health bar with a tweened fill and a Low state below 25 %.
symbols.notes: The fill scales on x (`bind:scale-x`, transform-origin at its left edge) and tweens; no relayout.

symbols.name: Counter
symbols.description: Resource counter whose number tweens and uses thousands separators.

symbols.name: Hotbar
symbols.description: Row of quick slots (`<repeat>`) with a selected slot.

ports.name: slots
ports.type: list<struct{key: string, count: number, empty: bool}>

symbols.notes: Controlled: `selected` (index) from the host; a click emits `select` with the entry index.

symbols.name: Crosshair
symbols.description: Reticle whose gap follows `spread`; Target state and hit flash.
symbols.notes: The hit flash is the `hit` timeline, playable from the host until symbol-scope play() works.

symbols.name: DamageNumber
symbols.description: Floating damage numbers (normal and critical), one spawned per hit.
symbols.notes: Set amount / crit / x / y (offset from the field's top-left), then fire `hit`: each hit spawns a DamagePop (its `pop` timeline, 0.45 s) that keeps the values it was spawned with. The file also defines DamageNumberList, the list-port alternative (`numbers: list<struct{amount, x, y, crit}>`, item-enter / item-exit).

symbols.name: Minimap
symbols.description: Round minimap frame around external content (`scene-view:minimap`).
symbols.notes: The map is `<external source="scene-view:minimap">`; the round frame does not clip external content to its radius.

symbols.name: CompassStrip
symbols.description: Heading strip scrolled by `heading` (degrees).
symbols.notes: The strip scrolls with `bind:translate-x` (a transform component; no relayout).

symbols.name: Subtitle
symbols.description: Subtitle line with speaker; text-reveal intro.
symbols.notes: The intro (text-reveal) runs from the host API until symbol-scope play() works; the Narrator voice hides the speaker.

symbols.name: Notification
symbols.description: Notification card with Info / Warning / Danger tones.

symbols.name: InputGlyph
symbols.description: Key cap showing the glyph of an input action plus a label.
symbols.notes: Fill the `glyph` slot with `<glyph key="<action>"/>`; without a glyph provider the action name shows as text.

symbols.name: ButtonPrompt
symbols.description: Rich-text prompt line with inline input glyphs.
symbols.notes: Fill the `text` slot with text and `<glyph key>` elements.

symbols.name: VirtualJoystick
symbols.description: Virtual thumbstick (>= 160 px): drag the pad to write `axis`, release re-centres it.
triggers: drag.value: set(axis, event.value | range(0, 1, -1, 1) | vec2(0)); set(knob, event.value | range(0, 1, -1, 1) | vec2(0))
release: set(active, false); set(axis, event.value | vec2(0)); set(knob, event.value | vec2(0)); play(release)
symbols.notes: The pad is `draggable="axis-x"`, so a drag writes only the x component (`axis` = (x, 0), x in -1..1); there is no vertical drag value yet, so `axis.y` stays 0 unless the host writes it. `dead` (the host sets 0.15) draws the dead-zone ring; the host applies the dead zone. Mode=Floating fades the base until active; the base does not move to the touch point (no pointer position in triggers).

symbols.name: TouchButton
symbols.description: Large round touch button (--touch-lg) with hold, auto-repeat and a cooldown shade.
triggers: press: sound(ui_click); set(held, true); emit(pressed); play(press); play(repeat, loop)
symbols.notes: Press emits `pressed`, sets `held` and loops the `repeat` timeline whose `tick` marker emits `repeat` every 0.25 s (a fixed interval: a symbol cannot take a `repeat-ms` attribute); `cooldown` (0..1, host-driven) scales a vertical shade rather than a conic ring and sets Cooling.

symbols.name: DPad
symbols.description: Four-way touch D-pad emitting `dir` with `direction` (0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left) and `axis`.
triggers: press: sound(ui_tick); set(direction, 0); set(axis, event.value | vec2(-1)); emit(dir); play(press)
press: sound(ui_tick); set(direction, 1); set(axis, event.value | offset(1) | vec2(0)); emit(dir); play(press)
press: sound(ui_tick); set(direction, 2); set(axis, event.value | vec2(1)); emit(dir); play(press)
press: sound(ui_tick); set(direction, 3); set(axis, event.value | offset(-1) | vec2(0)); emit(dir); play(press)
symbols.notes: Each arrow writes `direction` and `axis` (unit vector, y down) before emitting `dir`; release writes `axis` = (0, 0).

symbols.name: SwipeCard
symbols.description: Stacked swipe card: a left / right swipe emits `swipe` with `direction` -1 / 1 and flies the card out.
symbols.notes: The top card follows a horizontal drag through the local `offset` port and snaps back on release; the swipe gestures play `fly-left` / `fly-right`; the host swaps the content and plays `intro`.

symbols.name: BottomSheet
symbols.description: Bottom sheet docked to the bottom safe area; tap or swipe the grip to expand / collapse.
triggers: port(open): if gt(0) play(expand) else play(collapse)
symbols.notes: The symbol writes `open` itself (Toggle convention) and plays `expand` / `collapse` on every change; closing by dragging is approximated by the swipe(down) gesture (there is no vertical drag value).

symbols.name: TabBar
symbols.description: Bottom tab bar with 3-5 tabs (variant Count) inside the bottom safe area.
symbols.notes: A tap writes `value` and emits `select`; `value` (0-4) selects the Bar1..Bar5 state of the TabBar group.

symbols.name: TopBar
symbols.description: Top app bar that clears the status bar (top safe-area padding), with left / title / right slots.
symbols.notes: Its top padding is `1safe-top`; `intro` slides the bar in.

symbols.name: PullIndicator
symbols.description: Pull-to-refresh indicator driven by `progress` (0..1); reaching 1 loops `spin`.
symbols.notes: The host writes `progress` while the list is pulled and stops `spin` (stopTimeline) when the refresh is done.

symbols.name: ToggleTouch
symbols.description: Touch-size Toggle: the switch is --touch-min tall.
symbols.notes: A copy of Toggle (symbols have no `extends`); check / uncheck also play `flip`.

symbols.name: SliderTouch
symbols.description: Touch-size Slider: a --touch-min track and handle.
triggers: drag.value: set(value, event.value | range(0, 1, min, max) | round)
nav.value: sound(ui_tick); if lt(0) emit(decrease) else emit(increase)
symbols.notes: A copy of Slider (symbols have no `extends`); pressing the track plays `grab`.

symbols.name: PinchZoomView
symbols.description: Clipping container whose content is scaled by `scale` (clamped to min..max); pinch emits `pinch`.
symbols.notes: The gesture scale is not a trigger event value, so the host turns `pinch` into a new `scale` and resets it on `reset` (double tap).

symbols.name: ListItem
symbols.description: Reference list entry to copy (30.13): title / subtitle / selected in-ports, a trailing slot, a Selected state; emits `activate` and `dblactivate`.
symbols.notes: The list-entry pattern: values through in-ports (`bind:title="item(title)"` on the <use> in a <repeat> template), free content through the `trailing` slot (slot content may bind item() and document ports), states through bind:state (Selected follows `selected`). From a <repeat> entry the events carry the entry index.
